title: How a fly remembers a smell
summary: Send a smell into a real fly brain and find the cells that remember it.

steps.text: A fly smells with its antennae (its two feelers). Tap Stimulate to send a smell in. Watch the orange neurons light up.
steps.result: Those orange smell receptors (the smell catchers) fire first. Every smell starts here.

steps.text: Tap Stimulate again and follow the colors. Yellow projection neurons (the smell messengers) carry the smell inward. Blue Kenyon cells (the smell sorters) catch it next.
steps.result: The blue cells turn each smell into its own pattern.

steps.text: Tap Stimulate once more. Now watch the pink output neurons (the memory readers). They read the blue pattern.
steps.result: When a smell comes with sugar or danger, the links from blue to pink change. Scientists think that change is the memory.

steps.text: Now silence the Kenyon cells (the smell sorters). We will send the smell for you. What disappears?
steps.result: The pink light almost vanishes. The smell still gets in, but the memory readers get nothing to read.

steps.text: Tap the Kenyon cells (the smell sorters) button again to switch them back on. We will send the same smell.
steps.result: The pink light comes back. The fly can read its smell memory again.

check.question: You silenced the Kenyon cells (the blue cells). Why did the pink cells go dark?

choices.text: The smell never got into the fly.
choices.feedback: Not quite. The orange and yellow cells still lit up, so the smell got in. It stopped at the blue cells.

choices.text: The blue cells pass each smell's pattern to the pink cells.
choices.feedback: Yes! The blue cells sort each smell into a pattern, and the pink cells read it. No pattern means nothing to remember.

choices.text: You switched off the pink cells too.
choices.feedback: Not quite. You only switched off the blue cells. The pink cells stayed on but had nothing to read.

freePlay.title: Free play
freePlay.text: Every button works now. Guess first, then tap: what goes dark if you silence the yellow smell messengers? Try silencing two colors at once.
